hardGateFindings.finding: The repository supports Jamie's tending of the ten-day communal Open House, Time is Long as a realized installation making elapsed time physical, the image-comparison interface as a prototype, and the physical-room photograph-browsing work as a co-designed documented proposal. The first-person lineage and “same inquiry continues” wording clearly presents cross-period continuity as Jamie's interpretation, not as a quotation or conclusion attributed to Morse or Sack.

The candidate exposes no grade, student identifier, correspondence, contact detail, image, private locator, raw educational record, or unapproved participant identity. It uses only bounded public-safe summaries of the protected course and recommendation records.

The phrase “with value beyond organizational utility” explicitly rejects an employment-only justification for the artistic work, while attention, atmosphere, participation, representation, and care retain independent artistic and relational significance.

Jamie remains visible through “I tended” and “I also prototyped,” while “communal,” “co-designed,” “participation,” and the closing emphasis on people and relationships preserve shared inhabitation, collaborator agency, and participant contribution without assigning Jamie sole authorship.

dimensionFindings.finding: The candidate treats the realized installation's physical translation of elapsed time and movement through rooms as experiments in attention, atmosphere, participation, and representation, making bodily and spatial encounter legible as inquiry.

The ten-day duration and explicit statement that Jamie “tended” the communal Open House establish sustained presence; attention, atmosphere, participation, care, people, and place make the conditions of shared participation substantive rather than incidental.

The passage supplies concrete duration, media, and spatial translations: a ten-day Open House, a realized installation making elapsed time physical, an interface prototype joining social-network analysis with image comparison, and a proposal organized around movement through physical rooms. It also clearly repairs the earlier maturity collapse by distinguishing the realized installation, interface prototype, and co-designed documented proposal.

“My operating practice has an artistic lineage” and “The same inquiry continues” connect the bounded early specimens to civic, technical, and organizational work as a continuing inquiry, without claiming that the courses caused every later project or imposing a linear origin story.

A general reader can understand the relevance to Jamie's operating practice through the explicit civic, technical, and organizational connection, while the direct assertion of value beyond organizational utility keeps artistic, participatory, atmospheric, and relational value irreducible to professional usefulness.

limitations: The review is confined to public-safe repository records.
